Website policy

Privacy policy

Last updated · 7 October 2026

This policy covers this Withso company website, operated by Withso Technologies (OPC) Private Limited. Product accounts, field records and other in-product data are covered by the notices and policies of the relevant product.

Browsing this website

This website presents company and product information. It does not require an account, collect form submissions, or include advertising, behavioural analytics or tracking scripts.

Our hosting provider may process technical information, including IP addresses, browser details and request logs, to deliver and secure the website. Hosting access controls may use essential session cookies.

When you contact us

If you email us, we receive your email address and the information you send. We use it to respond to your enquiry and maintain the relevant business correspondence. Please share only information needed for your enquiry.

Product websites and external links

Links to Mapsmith, JurisField, NammaTN and other websites take you to separate services. Their privacy notices explain how those services handle information. This website’s policy does not replace them.

Sharing and retention

We do not sell personal information collected through correspondence. We share it only with service providers needed to handle the enquiry, where you request it, or when required by law. We retain correspondence for the enquiry, an ongoing business relationship, and any applicable legal obligations.

Your requests

For privacy questions or requests concerning information in our correspondence, email contact@withso.com. We will respond as required by applicable law. For product data requests, please use the contact information in that product’s privacy notice.

Changes and contact

We will update the date on this page when this website policy changes.
